dans_le_navigateur_du_telephone: In your phone's browser, nothing to install: every song split, analyzed and ready to practice.

arrivez_a_la_repete_en: Show up to rehearsal knowing the song
deposez_un_enregistrement_une_maquette: Drop in a recording, a demo or a YouTube link: a few seconds later the song is split and analyzed, on your server.
structure_en_parties_nommees_intro: Structure in named sections — Intro, Verse, Chorus, Bridge, Solo… always the same color, with A, B, C patterns.
accords_temps_par_temps_l: Chords beat by beat — the current and next chord in large type, C D E or Do Re Mi, transposition.
gamme_et_pentatonique_conseillee_pour: Key and suggested pentatonic scale to improvise over the solo.
corrections_partagees_un_membre_corrige: Shared corrections — one member fixes the sections, the whole band benefits.
chaque_morceau_est_separe_en: Every song is split into four tracks by a state-of-the-art AI: vocals, guitars, bass, drums. A real mixer, set and remembered for each song.
muet_et_solo_sur_chaque: Mute and Solo on every track, dB faders.
tempo_de_50_a_150: Tempo from 50% to 150% without changing the pitch.
boucles_au_sample_pres_repetitions: Sample-accurate loops, repeats ×2, ×3… and a trainer that speeds up step by step.
decompte_et_metronome_cales_sur: Count-in and metronome locked to the detected beats.
dans_la_voiture_ecran_verrouille: In the car: lock screen and CarPlay.
la_prise_tombe_pile_sur: Your take lands right on the song
appuyez_sur_decompte_lecture_de: Press ⏺: count-in, playback of whatever you want to hear, and the mic records. The take is aligned precisely thanks to a measurement of the phone's latency, and becomes a mixer track shared with the whole band.
une_prise_par_passage_quand: One take per pass when looping a section.
caler_coupe_debut_et_fin: "Align" trims start and end to bar lines, finding the "1" from the kick and snare.
vers_studio_one_dossier_projet: To Studio One: ready-to-open project folder, colored tracks, grid accurate from start to finish.
de_vos_fichiers_restent_chez: of your files stay at home
le_serveur_c_est_un: The server is a PC in your band
aucun_fichier_ne_part_chez: No file goes to a hosting company. Even the AI runs on your machine: nothing is sent to an online service. The only storage limit is your hard drive.
aucune_perte_silencieuse_copies_en: No silent data loss: conflict copies instead of overwrites, 30-day trash and version history.
verrous_automatiques_quand_cubase_ou: Automatic locks when Cubase or Studio One opens a project: nobody overwrites someone else's session.
transferts_reprenables_une_coupure_en: Resumable transfers: a dropped connection mid-upload of a multi-GB session loses nothing.
sauvegarde_quotidienne_et_verification_d: Daily backup and a weekly integrity check.
calculs_lourds_la_nuit_le: Heavy processing overnight: next morning, everything is ready.
ce_qu_aucun_autre_outil: What no other tool brings together
fait_pour_ceux_qui_jouent: Made for people who play together
chacun_arrive_a_la_repete: Everyone shows up to rehearsal knowing their part, at the right tempo.
de_la_repete_au_studio: From rehearsal to studio without manual realigning or overwritten sessions.
un_morceau_toutes_les_pistes: One song, every track, at each student's tempo.
vos_maquettes_inedites_ne_quittent: Your unreleased demos never leave your home.
une_seule_personne_s_occupe: One person takes care of the server. Everyone else just clicks a link.
sur_un_pc_windows_du: On a Windows PC in your band (even an old PC sitting in a closet). Band name, your nickname, and you're set.
par_whatsapp_par_mail_ou: By WhatsApp, email or QR code. Each member just picks a nickname.
le_dossier_apparait_sur_le: The folder appears on every PC's desktop, and the app on everyone's phone home screen.
oui_pas_d_abonnement_pas: Yes. No subscription, no paid version, no ads. If the project helps you, you can support its development with a donation, no obligation.
un_pc_windows_10_ou: A Windows 10 or 11 PC (64-bit) that acts as the server and stays on, with disk space for your songs. Other members use their Windows PC and/or their phone (iPhone or Android), with nothing to install on the phone.
pas_encore_pour_le_serveur: Not yet for the server or the synced folder. The web app, however, works in any browser, including on Mac, iPhone and iPad.
et_en_dehors_de_la: What about away from home, on mobile data?
oui_grace_a_tailscale_gratuit: Yes, thanks to Tailscale (free), built into the setup wizard: nothing to configure on your router, nothing to install on phones. At home, PCs keep using the local network, which is faster for big WAV files.
mes_morceaux_sont_ils_envoyes: Are my songs sent to an online AI?
non_la_separation_des_instruments: No. Instrument separation and chord, tempo and structure detection all run on your server. Nothing is sent to an online service.
faut_il_une_carte_graphique: Do I need a graphics card?
non_les_calculs_lourds_separation: No. Heavy processing (separation, fine analysis) runs overnight at low priority so the server stays responsive. Next day, everything is ready.
vos_fichiers_et_les_donnees: Your files and the server data are kept. Reinstalling or updating brings everything back: accounts, history, trash.

req_server_lead: The PC that holds the band's songs and stays on. An older PC is fine.
req_cpu_rec: 4 cores or more, with AVX2 (Intel 4th gen, AMD Ryzen or newer)
req_ram_rec: 16 GB if the PC is also used for other things
req_gpu_rec: Not needed: heavy processing runs overnight
req_soft_rec: On the system drive (the songs can go on another disk)
req_disk_rec: A dedicated disk of 500 GB to 1 TB, plus an external disk for backups
req_power_min: Stays on, sleep turned off when plugged in
req_net_min: 5 Mbit/s, to listen on mobile data
req_net_rec: 20 Mbit/s or more (fiber) for several members or big files
req_storage_lead: 28JoursBox itself adds little: about 45 MB per analyzed song for the separated tracks (measured: 154 songs = 6.9 GB). What fills the disk is your own files: rehearsal WAVs and Cubase / Studio One projects. Edited and deleted files are also kept 30 days (versions and trash).
req_ex1: 100 songs in MP3 / m4a (about 5 MB each)
req_ex2: 100 rehearsals in WAV, 4 min (about 40 MB each)
req_ex3: 20 multitrack Cubase / Studio One projects (1 to 5 GB each)
req_ex_note: Tracks are separated automatically overnight for m4a files, and on request for WAV and MP3. Plan an external disk of the same size as your data for backups.
req_time_text: Each new song is prepared overnight (1 am to 7 am): beats, chords, separated tracks and fine analysis. Measured on an 8-core PC: about 2.6 minutes of processing per minute of music, so about 10 minutes for a 4-minute song and around 30 songs per night. On a 4-core PC, count about twice as long. New songs are ready the next morning; a large first import can take a few nights.
req_members_text: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. About 320 MB for the software, plus the space of the folders you choose to keep on this PC. Cubase or Studio One optional: project locks are set automatically if they're installed.
req_phones_text: iPhone or Android with a recent browser (Safari, Chrome). Nothing to install, no storage used: songs play from the server. On mobile data, listening uses about 0.2 to 0.3 Mbit/s.
